t: Productive Bees builds on top of vanilla bees. Some understanding of the vanilla system is assumed in this guide.
资源蜜蜂建立在原版蜜蜂机制之上。本指南默认你已经对原版系统有一定了解。

In addition to vanilla bees you'll come across a range of new bees living in well hidden $(l:hives/nests)nests$(/l) in different biomes around the overworld. These bees are solitary meaning they will not live in a hive. However, their genetics allow for breeding different types of bees, plus they look cool.
除了原版蜜蜂外，你还会在主世界各个群系中发现许多栖息在隐蔽$(l:hives/nests)蜂巢$(/l)中的新蜜蜂。这些蜜蜂都是独居的，也就是说它们不会住进蜂箱里。不过，它们的遗传特性允许你繁殖出不同类型的蜜蜂，而且它们看起来也很酷。

First thing you need to find is a vanilla bee nest to get some honey bottles and honeycombs. The honey bottles are needed to craft $(l:items/bee_cage)Bee Cages$(/l) which makes it much easier to transport bees to your home.
你首先需要找到一个原版蜂巢，以获取一些蜂蜜瓶和蜜脾。蜂蜜瓶是合成$(l:items/bee_cage)蜜蜂笼$(/l)所必需的，这能让你更轻松地把蜜蜂运回家。

Once you've collected enough honeycombs, build yourself an $(l:hives/advanced_hives)advanced beehive$(/l) and an $(l:hives/expansion_boxes)expansion box$(/l). The $(l:hives/advanced_hives)advanced beehive$(/l) allows you to look inside and keep an eye on your bees and what they produce.
收集到足够多的蜜脾后，给自己建造一个$(l:hives/advanced_hives)高级蜂箱$(/l)和一个$(l:hives/expansion_boxes)扩容盒$(/l)。$(l:hives/advanced_hives)高级蜂箱$(/l)可以让你查看内部情况，随时留意你的蜜蜂以及它们产出的东西。
Some bees can only be found in other dimensions or obtained through breeding. Use JEI to look up the breeding recipes so you know which bees you need to find.
有些蜜蜂只能在其他维度中找到，或通过繁殖获得。使用 JEI 查阅繁殖配方，这样你就能知道需要先找到哪些蜜蜂。
